difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S flat locally of finite presentation between spaces over S and E pseudo-coherent in D(O_X), the lemma gives: E is S-perfect iff E is locally bounded below and for every s in S the derived fibre pullback L(X_s -> X)^* E is locally bounded below. The retained proof is written: everything in sight (perfectness, boundedness, fibre pullback) is local on X and S, so the chapter's affine-locality dictionary (lemma affine-locally-rel-perfect) reduces to X = Spec(B), S = Spec(A) affine; the affine case is exactly the schemes theorem Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma bounded-on-fibres (the amplitude criterion for perfect complexes over a base ring via fibre boundedness), quoted by name. Retained author proof at lines 12772-12778.
